_chapters.第三章 成巫の動機と過程: Chapter 3. Motives and Process of Becoming a Shaman

p0014_1.t: Total Number of Shamans by Province (August 1930)
p0014_1.d: Number of shamans in each province as of August 1930, with the number of districts that made no report, and the national total.

p0014_2.d: Number of police districts, and their share of the total, in which commoners, outcastes (chŏnmin) or yangban are the leading social origin of shamans, August 1930.

p0015_1.t: Statistics of Shamans' Social Origin by Province
p0015_1.d: Number of districts per province where commoners or outcastes predominate and where some shamans are of yangban origin, with remarks on blind shamans.

p0016_1.d: Number of female shamans (mudang) and male shamans (paksu) per province, and the number of districts where one sex outnumbers the other, with national totals.

p0017_1.d: Ranking of three age groups (under 30, 30 to 50, over 50) among shamans of both sexes.

p0017_2.t: Districts Where Each Age Group Predominates, by Province
p0017_2.d: Number of districts per province in which shamans aged under 30, 30 to 50, or over 50 are most numerous, with totals and percentages.

p0018_1.t: Population and Shamans: Ratio by Province
p0018_1.d: Population (end of 1929), number of shamans (August 1930) and shamans per 100,000 population for each province.

p0019_1.t: Distribution Map of Shamans by Province (Legend)
p0019_1.d: Legend of the provincial map giving the shading classes by number of shamans per province; map shading not transcribed.

p0020_1.t: Distribution Map of Shamans by County, Kyŏnggi-do (August 1930)
p0020_1.d: Legend of the county map of Kyŏnggi-do giving shading classes by shamans per 100,000 population, with total population and shaman count.

p0021_1.t: Distribution Map of Shamans by County and Island, Chŏlla-namdo (August 1930)
p0021_1.d: Legend of the county and island map of Chŏlla-namdo giving shading classes by shamans per 100,000 population, with total population and shaman count.

p0032_1.d: Names for shamans in use in each county, listed by province and county as reported by the police, August 1930.

p0045_1.t: Statistics of Motives for Becoming a Shaman
p0045_1.d: Number of districts per province reporting each motive for becoming a shaman (heredity, divine inspiration, livelihood, dissipation, other), with rank order, from 1930 police reports.

p0045_2.t: Motives and Routes to Becoming a Shaman, by County
p0045_2.d: County-by-county replies, by province, giving the ranked motives (heredity, livelihood, inspiration, dissipation) and the way each type of shaman learned the craft.

p0065_1.t: Motives and Training Period of Shamans in the Wŏnju District
p0065_1.d: Number of 37 shamans in the Wŏnju district, Kangwŏn-do, by motive for becoming a shaman and by length or manner of training.

p0105_1.t: Rain-Making Rites by Shamans in the Koryŏ Period
p0105_1.d: Chronological list of royal-ordered rain-making rites by shamans under the Koryŏ dynasty, giving the date, method and place.

p0106_1.t: Rain-Making Rites by Shamans in the Yi Dynasty
p0106_1.d: Chronological list from the Veritable Records of royal rain-making rites by shamans under the Yi dynasty, giving the date, place, number of shamans, duration and remarks.

p0229_1.d: List of seasonal shamanic rites through the year, with a short description of each.

p0258_1.t: Tan'gol Shaman Households in Taedŏk-myŏn, Changhŭng County
p0258_1.d: Shaman households in the villages of Taedŏk-myŏn, Changhŭng County, Chŏlla-namdo that hold tan'gol (hereditary client) families, listing the male and female shamans with name, age and social status.
